name: Collegeboxes
summary: Collegeboxes, a U-Haul company, will pick up at Texas A&M and store boxes at U-Haul on Texas Ave. A standard box is $56 for 4 months on the national list, and the school page adds a $37 fee per package received. Call first: the school page says room pickup is currently unavailable. Checked Nov 24, 2026.
address: Stored at U-Haul Moving & Storage at Texas Ave, 2813 Texas Ave, College Station, TX 77845

fees.label: Collegebox or standard moving box, 4-month storage term
fees.per: item, pickup and delivery included on the national price list
fees.note: This $56 is for a Collegebox, a box smaller than 24 x 16 x 18 inches, the supply-kit outer box, or a U-Haul small, medium, or large box. It is on the national list, not the Texas A&M page. Ask if your order uses it.

fees.label: Small item (lamp, fan, microwave, and similar)
fees.note: National storage price list. Pickup and delivery included. No registration fee on that list.

fees.label: Medium item (suitcase, bin, nightstand, and similar)
Large item (mini fridge, larger box up to 8 cubic feet)
Extra-large item (bicycle, desk, chair, twin mattress)
XX-large item (futon, couch, unboxed television)
Handling fee on the Texas A&M page
fees.note: The Texas A&M page says a $37 handling fee applies for each box received on the student's behalf. The national pricing page lists a $30 per-box handling fee for Ship to School, covering receipt, up to one month of storage, and room delivery. These are different published numbers.

fees.label: Ship to School handling fee on the national price list
fees.note: Described as shipment acceptance, up to one month of storage near school, and delivery to the room. The Texas A&M page prints $37 instead.

fees.label: Signature supply kit
fees.note: 5 reusable boxes (24 x 16 x 18 inches), 1 roll of U-Haul tape, 5 zip ties, 1 bonus box (36 x 24 x 7 inches), 1 marker, and 10 FedEx label pouches. The page says kits ship immediately after purchase.

fees.label: Ship Home, in-state estimate
fees.note: National estimate. The same section says FedEx pickup and delivery, live tracking, and no handling fees. Exact price depends on destination, size, and weight. This is not a quote to a specific hometown.

fees.label: Ship Home, regional estimate
Ship Home, coast-to-coast estimate
Pickup or delivery off the scheduled dates
fees.note: National fee schedule. The Texas A&M page says to contact them for a different date, without restating this dollar amount.

fees.label: Self-service pickup or drop-off at the storage location
Heavy box, 50 pounds or more
Declared value included, with optional extra coverage
fees.note: The national storage section says every order includes shipping protection up to $100 per box, and extra coverage starts at $3 per $100. A separate block on the Texas A&M page mentions $1,000 coverage in a U-Box style list. Which coverage applies to a given TAMU order is not spelled out in one place.

fees.label: Miscellaneous specialty item, 4-month term
fees.note: Listed under the storage tiers. The page does not give examples.

fees.label: XXL furniture, 100 pounds or more, 4-month term
Ship to School, in-state estimate
fees.per: box, and the page says this range includes the $30 handling fee
fees.note: This is Ship to School, not Ship Home. Ship Home in-state is still $45 to $60, and that section says there is no handling fee.

fees.label: Ship to School, regional estimate
fees.per: box, and the page says this range includes the $30 handling fee
fees.note: The page says regional means nearby states and does not list them.

fees.label: Ship to School, coast-to-coast estimate
fees.per: box, and the page says this range includes the $30 handling fee

facts.label: Published room delivery
facts.value: Tuesday, January 19, 2027, 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Ship to School sign-up by Thursday, January 7, 2027.

facts.label: Service status on the school page
facts.value: The page says full-service moving is currently unavailable, and it also lists dorm pickup dates and a dorm-pickup FAQ.
facts.note: Both statements are on the Texas A&M page. Confirm which service can actually be booked before paying.

facts.label: University relationship
facts.value: No Active Partnership with Texas A&M University, College Station.

facts.label: Storage building
facts.value: U-Haul Moving & Storage at Texas Ave, 2813 Texas Ave, College Station, TX 77845. Collegeboxes says this is just over 3 miles from campus, at Texas Ave and Harvey Mitchell Parkway S.

facts.label: Access while stored
facts.value: Collegeboxes says students can access belongings during business hours with three business days' notice.

gaps: The Texas A&M page does not print the $56 box rate. That number lives on the national price list.
Whether the $37 handling fee is added on top of the $56 storage rate is not stated.
A spring 2027 university finals calendar was not checked, so May 10, 2027 is a Collegeboxes date, not a confirmed university move-out date.
Off-campus pickup pricing is not published. The page says to contact them.
The school page still contains a sentence about a facility near Northeastern University in Boston. Treat stray sentences as a reason to confirm your order, not as a College Station fact.
